description.p: Sulafat is the SSH client of the Lyra OS ecosystem, for connecting to Linux/Unix desktops and servers. It works on any modern Linux distribution, with GTK4/libadwaita giving it native visual integration with GNOME and Lyra.

Sulafat é o cliente SSH do ecossistema Lyra OS, para conexão com máquinas Linux/Unix (desktops e servidores). Funciona em qualquer distribuição Linux moderna, com integração visual nativa ao GNOME e ao Lyra via GTK4/libadwaita.

Sulafat es el cliente SSH del ecosistema Lyra OS para conectarse a equipos Linux/Unix de escritorio y servidores. Funciona en cualquier distribución Linux moderna, con integración visual nativa con GNOME y Lyra mediante GTK4/libadwaita.
Sulafat 是 Lyra OS 生态系统中的 SSH 客户端，用于连接 Linux/Unix 桌面和服务器。它可在任何现代 Linux 发行版上运行，并通过 GTK4/libadwaita 与 GNOME 和 Lyra 实现原生视觉集成。

ul.li: Hosts managed straight from your existing ~/.ssh/config, with search, groups and color
Sessions in tabs, powered by the real OpenSSH client and an embedded VTE terminal
Keys, ssh-agent, known_hosts, certificates, ProxyJump: all handled by OpenSSH itself
Quick connect to user@host without saving a profile
One click to open a host's files over SFTP in the default file manager

Sessões em abas usando o cliente OpenSSH real e um terminal VTE integrado
Chaves, ssh-agent, known_hosts, certificados e ProxyJump gerenciados pelo OpenSSH
Conexão rápida a usuário@host sem salvar um perfil
Um clique para abrir os arquivos do host por SFTP no gerenciador de arquivos padrão

Un clic para abrir los archivos del host por SFTP en el gestor de archivos predeterminado

description.p: Hardens SSH configuration validation and persistence, adds IPv6 quick-connect support, conflict detection, rotating backups, and visible error handling.
Removed the New Window entry from the application menu.
First stable release, with Settings and About available from the application menu.
Redesigned application icon with clearer SSH terminal and key imagery.
